purpose: Public suggested covers. Original files kept unchanged. Output size must be reported honestly when enlarged.
resolution_note: The prompts requested 3840x2160, but the tool returned 1672x941. The app discloses enlargement for higher-resolution output.

prompts.name: coast
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single spectacular colorful high resolution landscape photograph for a selectable artwork background in a privacy app. Dominican Caribbean coastline at golden hour, turquoise clear water with visible reef patterns, lush green palms on a graceful beach curve, dramatic peach and coral sunset sky, cinematic natural light, detailed foliage, elegant balanced composition. Landscape aspect ratio 16:9, request 3840x2160 PNG. Edge-to-edge artwork only. No text, no frame, no UI, no watermark, no people. Preserve rich natural color and crisp fine detail.
